---
title: "Popularity of the Name Angel Over Time"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

names_df <- read_csv("ssa-baby-names.csv")

names_df |>
  filter(name == "Angel") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = count, color = sex)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Babies Named 'Angel' in the U.S. (1880–2025)",
    subtitle = "Annual count by sex from Social Security Administration records",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies",
    color = "Sex",
    caption = "Source: Social Security Administration"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
